Title: Init Bun workspace scaffold
Description: package.json (deps: hono, handlebars→mustache.js, linkedom; devDeps: wrangler, @cloudflare/workers-types, @types/bun), tsconfig.json (editor support only), .gitignore, bun install + commit bun.lock

Title: Create site config

Acceptance Criteria: Config parses as JSON; types imported by worker + tests
Notes: Single source of truth — version bumps propagate to CTAs, JSON-LD, /download redirect

Title: Vendor client assets
Description: Download htmx 2.0.10 + Alpine 3.16.2 minified into public/vendor (self-hosted); copy design/app.ico → public/favicon.ico and design/icon.png → public/icon.png
Acceptance Criteria: Files present at pinned versions
Notes: Matches desktop-app vendoring approach

Title: Port design tokens CSS
Description: Port :root tokens verbatim from design/landing.html plus reset/base layer (bare-tag typography inside .section/.container) and responsive breakpoints 1080/860/560 + reduced-motion guard
Acceptance Criteria: Token sets verified identical to landing.html :root block
Notes: Moved from src/css/ to public/css/ during A6 rework so the free asset path serves it

Title: Hono worker + wrangler wiring
Description: Minimal Hono app (headers, /healthz, /download redirect, notFound stub) + wrangler.jsonc; smoke test under bunx wrangler dev
Acceptance Criteria: wrangler dev boots; assets served; /healthz ok; unmatched path reaches worker; /download 302s to R2 URL
Notes: Smoke passed 2026-08-23; superseded by A6 routing rework

Title: Rework scaffold for on-the-fly model
Description: wrangler.jsonc → assets directory ./public with html_handling none, not_found_handling none, run_worker_first [/, /404.html, /*.html]; add kv_namespaces CACHE binding (placeholder id, local sim in dev); Text rules scoped to src/**/*.html so public pages can never bundle; move site.css → public/css/; delete build stub; package.json scripts reduced to dev/test/deploy
Acceptance Criteria: wrangler dev serves css/vendor/favicon from free asset path; / hits worker; raw pages never served unexpanded
Notes: Implements decision: on-the-fly expansion + KV cache; pages live at public/{slug}.html

Title: Element registry (mustache)
Description: registry.ts imports element/layout vanilla .html templates as text modules via wrangler Text rules; ElementDef { templateName, mapper(api), collect? }; ElementApi = attrs()/slot()/child()/outer()/text(); mustache.js renderer (zero deps, no eval — workers-safe by construction)
Acceptance Criteria: Registry loads partial set under Bun and wrangler without error
Notes: Templates must not be publicly fetchable — bundling keeps them out of assets

Title: Pure expander function
Description: src/expander.ts expandPage(source, ctx, registry) returns body/meta/collected; linkedom parseHTML (full-doc normalization for bare fragments); deepest-first e-* expansion via outerHTML replacement; slot= overrides; nesting supported; unknown tags left untouched as visible signal; zero I/O
Acceptance Criteria: Fixture page with nested e-* expands fully; zero unexpanded tags in output body
Notes: Deepest-first so slotted children resolve before parents render

Title: Meta resolution + layout render
Description: meta.ts extractMeta/resolveMeta with precedence page > config > derived; layouts/base.html shell with meta/canonical/OG/Twitter/nav/footer; trusted URL fields use triple-stache because mustache default escaping entity-encodes slashes (regression-tested)
Acceptance Criteria: Rendered output has complete head; OG defaults injected when not overridden
Notes: Authored head stripped after extraction

Title: Worker routes
Description: worker/app.ts createApp({defs?, partials?, layout?}): / expands index.html; /{slug}[/] expands public/{slug}.html via ASSETS binding fetch; *.html probes 301 to clean URLs; sitemap.xml + robots.txt generated from manifest slugs; /download 302; /healthz; fallback expands 404.html with status 404; security headers on all worker responses
Acceptance Criteria: Every route behaves per plan section 6 table; unknown slug renders expanded 404
Notes: manifest.ts lists slugs; sync-tested against public/*.html

Title: KV cache layer
Description: rev = sha256(config + REGISTRY_VERSION + layout + all partial sources) memoized per isolate; key {rev}:{slug}:{sha256(source)} scopes invalidation per page edit; miss path responds then waitUntil(CACHE.put ttl 30d); Cache-Control public max-age=300 on HTML responses
Acceptance Criteria: Second identical request served from KV without re-expansion (route test asserts puts==1 gets==2)
Notes: Cold-miss races do redundant idempotent work — no locks by design

Title: Test suite green
Description: bun test 19/19 green: expander fixtures (nesting/slots/collect/unknown-tag/head-extraction), meta precedence, JSON-LD shapes, route integration via hono/testing app.request with mock ASSETS/KV against the REAL production layout, manifest-public sync, raw-leak guard (/index.html never raw), URL-escape regression guard (no / in output)
Acceptance Criteria: bun test exits 0; every fixture element exercised through full pipeline
Notes: Tests gate Phase C porting

Title: Single Alpine entry
Description: public/js/app.js registers every interactive component via alpine:init (nav toggle + download toast shipped; more land with each Phase C/D element); loaded before vendored alpine.min.js so both defer in document order; elements opt in via x-data attribute
Acceptance Criteria: wrangler dev serves /js/app.js from free asset path; layout wires it before alpine.min.js
Notes: One file = one place to audit client behavior
